summary_en: 3,000,000 shares of common stock to be cancelled as of November 30, 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares including treasury stock will total 90,616,650 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 10, 2026, the Board of Directors of TOMY COMPANY, LTD. (ticker: 7867, Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market) resolved to cancel 3,000,000 shares of treasury common stock pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is scheduled to become effective on November 30, 2026.

Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares of the company, including treasury stock, will be 90,616,650 shares. The disclosure does not provide information on the proportion of cancelled shares relative to outstanding shares, outstanding shares at the date of disclosure, or the company's stated reason for the cancellation.
